task_name: Routing Linear (Configure R1 for L3 Forwarding)
intents: Ensure that PC1 (10.0.1.2/24 on eth1) can ping PC2 (10.0.2.2/24 on eth1) across router R1.
On R1, assign 10.0.1.1/24 to interface eth1 and 10.0.2.1/24 to interface eth2.
ground_truth_reasoning: PC1 and PC2 are pre-configured (by lab exec/startup) with IPv4 addresses and a static route to the remote subnet via R1. To enable end-to-end connectivity, R1 must be configured with IPv4 addresses on both links and IPv4 forwarding must be enabled so it can route packets between 10.0.1.0/24 and 10.0.2.0/24.

baseline_invariants.name: PC1 management interface eth0 is still up
R1 management interface eth0 is still up
PC2 management interface eth0 is still up
